metric_explanations.worst_rebalance_capacity_estimated_impac: Modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the tightest impact-model rebalance capacity.
metric_explanations.current_size_vs_median_capacity: Ratio of the configured current portfolio size to the median impact-consistent capacity.
metric_explanations.current_worst_name_impact_bps_median: Median modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the configured current portfolio size across rebalances.
metric_explanations.current_worst_name_impact_bps_p75: 75th percentile modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the configured current portfolio size.
metric_explanations.current_worst_name_impact_bps_max: Maximum modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the configured current portfolio size.

metric_explanations.alpha_daily: Regression intercept in daily return units after controlling for the listed factors.
metric_explanations.alpha_annualized: Daily alpha scaled by observations per year; rough annualized residual return estimate.
metric_explanations.betas: Factor sensitivities; positive means the strategy tends to rise when that factor rises, negative means the opposite.
metric_explanations.r_squared: 0 to 1. Share of return variance explained by the regression factors.
metric_explanations.observations: Number of aligned return observations used in the regression.
metric_explanations.factors_used: Factor columns that were present and actually used in the regression.
metric_explanations.excess_return_regression: True when the dependent variable was strategy excess returns after subtracting the risk-free rate.

factor_explanations.SMB: Small minus big size factor; positive indicates a tilt toward smaller companies.
factor_explanations.HML: High minus low value factor; positive indicates a value tilt, negative a growth tilt.
factor_explanations.RMW: Robust minus weak profitability factor; positive indicates a tilt toward more profitable firms.
factor_explanations.CMA: Conservative minus aggressive investment factor; positive indicates a tilt toward firms investing more conservatively.
factor_explanations.MOM: Momentum factor; positive indicates a tilt toward recent winners.
factor_explanations.LT_REV: Long-term reversal factor; positive indicates a tilt toward long-term losers rebounding.
factor_explanations.ST_REV: Short-term reversal factor; positive indicates a tilt toward short-term losers rebounding.
